verdict.rationale: Docs show holds reducing available balance without moving money (docs-14), webhooks fired for card authorizations and general transaction lifecycle events (docs-5, docs-15, docs-20), a fallback Events API for polling (docs-24), and customer evidence of ingesting webhooks for each step of the ACH lifecycle and live payment status tracking (docs-29, docs-36, docs-45). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a dedicated real-time balance-read endpoint reflecting holds/pending activity, and independent (non-vendor) confirmation that webhook coverage is complete for every state transition.
